jobs.title: 2027 US Electrical Engineering Internship
jobs.description_text:
Your Impact

As an intern on the Axon Electrical Engineering team, you will gain hands-on experience alongside senior engineers and mentors. You’ll contribute to the design, development, testing, and debugging of cutting-edge electronic circuits that power Axon’s products.

Your academic knowledge and engineering curiosity will be put into practice in real-world applications—from prototyping through validation. You’ll also collaborate with mechanical and software engineers to help bring world-class products to market.

This is your opportunity to deepen your electronics and product design expertise while supporting technologies that positively impact law enforcement, public safety, and the communities they serve.

What You'll Do

  • Support the TASER electrical engineering team in designing, developing, testing, debugging, and building new products throughout the development cycle.
  • Collaborate with peers and senior engineers to deliver robust electronic designs.
  • Develop and execute test plans, define test methods, and validate designs.
  • Bring up, characterize, and debug systems and circuits using lab tools (oscilloscopes, multimeters, logic analyzers, power supplies, hi-pot testers, etc.).
  • Evaluate and document design outcomes and test results; present findings to design teams for review.
  • Review product design requirements in relation to system objectives.

jobs.description_text:
AI Security Researcher / Research Engineer

Remote or hybrid - London preferred but North America, EU, UK accepted

About Brave:

Brave is on a mission to protect the human right to privacy online. We’ve built a free web browser that blocks creepy ads and trackers by default, a private search engine with a truly independent index, private AI assistant, latest privacy and security features, and a private ad network (opt-in!) that directly rewards you for your attention. Already over 120 million people regularly use Brave for a faster, more private web. Millions more switch every month.

The internet is a sea of ads, hackers, and echo chambers. Big Tech makes huge profits off our data, and tells us what’s true and what’s not. Brave is fighting back. Join us!
